lessonTitle: What Medical Affairs Is — and Why It Exists

slides.title: The Gap Approval Doesn't Close
bullets: Regulatory approval is not the same as correct real-world use
A drug label tells a physician what a medicine is for
It rarely answers the exact question in front of a specific patient
Medical Affairs exists to close that gap

slides.title: From Reactive Support to Strategic Pillar
bullets: Once: answered unsolicited medical questions, supported dossiers
Today: McKinsey calls it the industry's "third pillar"
Standing alongside R&D and Commercial — not between them

slides.title: Medical Affairs Leaders Reporting Directly to the CEO
slides.caption: Nearly doubled in four years — McKinsey / MAPS industry analysis

slides.title: Independence From Commercial
bullets: No sales targets — ever
Every interaction must stand on its own as balanced and evidence-based
Protected by codes: IFPMA, EFPIA, PhRMA
A legal and ethical requirement, not a cultural preference

slides.title: Five Core Activities
bullets: Scientific engagement with HCPs and KOLs
Medical insight generation that informs strategy
Evidence generation — RWE, investigator studies, registries
Medical education and publications
Medical information services

slides.title: Why This Foundation Matters
bullets: Your value proposition is scientific credibility — not sales influence
Every technique in this course builds on that credibility
Lose it, and Medical Affairs loses its reason to exist

takeaway.title: Medical Affairs closes the gap between approval and appropriate use
bullets: Independence from Commercial is what makes it trustworthy
Its five core activities all defend that scientific credibility
This foundation underpins everything else in the course
